services.value: Endyne provides full-service chemical and microbiological laboratory testing and environmental/product testing. Services include wastewater and sludge analysis, municipal drinking water and private water testing, and microbiological testing, along with supplies/services such as sample containers and courier bottle pickup delivery for transporting samples.
